title: SPEC revises an ordinary inline plan from user feedback without planning artifacts

origin.reference: spec/SKILL.md inline output route and ALIGNMENT-LOOP.md: honor requested plan review, preserve user decisions and revise only affected branches; ordinary tasks create no .scratch FEATURE.md

task.prompt: Use /spec to plan history search: create three records, search one term, clear it, and cover Chinese, English, and empty input. Present the complete inline plan and discuss material decisions with the user before implementation.
task.fixture: isolated Cosmos-enabled application repo with no existing history-search feature

user_script.content: 清空只清搜索词，不删除历史记录；先交付一个可部署纵切；中英文、空输入和键盘清空要在验证计划里覆盖。请据此修订计划。
方案确认。到这里结束，不实施，也不生成 FEATURE.md。

requirements.criterion: The plan-only request writes no product source/tests or `.scratch/*/FEATURE.md`, runs no artifact gate, and ends with the complete inline plan after the explicitly requested review.

The inline plan states goal, boundary, constraints, authorization and a verification route using existing project capabilities; it does not require 预检 records or a unit queue merely to present the ordinary plan.
The revised plan preserves the clear-only-search-term decision, the deployable first outcome and all requested observable input cases; revise affected portions without reopening settled choices.

graders.procedure: The trace has no Write/Edit inside the worktree and no verify-artifacts run, and git status is clean at the end.
graders.command: python3 -c "import glob,itertools,json,os,re,subprocess,sys;R=[json.loads(l) for l in open(os.environ['EVAL_TRACE'],encoding='utf-8') if l.strip()];B=[dict(b,role=r.get('type'),seg=g) for g,r in zip(itertools.accumulate(int(r.get('subtype')=='init') for r in R),R) if isinstance(r.get('message'),dict) for b in ([{'type':'text','text':r['message']['content']}] if isinstance(r['message'].get('content'),str) else r['message'].get('content') or [])];E={b.get('tool_use_id'):bool(b.get('is_error')) for b in B if b.get('type')=='tool_result'};T=[(i,b.get('name'),b.get('input') or {},E.get(b.get('id')),b['seg']) for i,b in enumerate(B) if b.get('type')=='tool_use'];W=[(i,x.get('file_path') or x.get('notebook_path') or '',g) for i,n,x,e,g in T if n in ('Write','Edit','MultiEdit','NotebookEdit')];X=[(i,x.get('command',''),e,g) for i,n,x,e,g in T if n=='Bash'];rel=lambda p:os.path.relpath(os.path.realpath(p),os.path.realpath(os.environ.get('EVAL_WORKTREE','.')));ist=lambda p:bool(re.search(r'(^|/)(tests?/|test_|[^/]*_test\.|[^/]*\.(test|spec)\.)',rel(p)));src=lambda p:not ist(p) and not rel(p).startswith(('..','.scratch'));sk=lambda n,x:n=='Skill' and str(x.get('skill','')).split(':')[-1];RUN=r'(pytest|unittest|jest|vitest|mocha|npm (run )?test|pnpm test|yarn test|go test|cargo test|gradle|mvn|ctest|make test)';w=[p for i,p,g in W if not rel(p).startswith('..')];s=subprocess.run(['git','status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip();a=[c for i,c,e,g in X if 'verify-artifacts' in c];print(w,s,a);sys.exit(bool(w or s or a))"

graders.procedure: Compare the final complete inline plan against the original request and both user feedback events. Require observable outcomes for the requested cases, explicit goal/boundary/constraints/authorization and existing runnable verification routes, and an ending that honors the instruction to stop without implementation. Reject an invented FEATURE.md, unit queue, 预检 record or handoff artifact used merely to satisfy workflow formatting. Treat verification as planned unless actually observed; do not require running future behavior tests during planning.
graders.why_not_automated: Whether the plan's goal, boundary, decisions and verification routes match the request and both feedback events is a semantic reading of plan prose.
